items.title: Q1 earnings begin on a strong note as banks fuel double-digit growth
items.description: For a common sample of 164 companies, revenue grew 17.5% on a low base a year ago, the fastest in at least nine quarters. Net profit rose 14.5% year-on-year, marking a second consecutive quarter of double-digit growth. In the year-ago period, revenue and profit had risen by 4.7% and 11.5%, respectively.

items.title: Refining gains, clean energy push lift Reliance outlook despite retail drag
items.description: Reliance Industries' energy division performance offset retail and Jio BP weakness in the June quarter. Elevated product cracks are expected to benefit refining margins due to global fuel supply disruptions. The company aims for peak refinery utilization through diversified crude sourcing and integrated oil-to-chemicals operations. Its upstream business is entering a new investment cycle to sustain production levels. Clean energy segment capacity reached one gigawatt, with battery manufacturing on schedule.

items.title: UltraTech Cement Q1 Results: Cons profit jumps 17% YoY to Rs 2,599 crore; revenue rises 16%
items.description: UltraTech Cement Q1 Results: UltraTech reported a 17% YoY rise in Q1FY27 consolidated net profit to Rs 2,599 crore, while revenue increased 16% to Rs 24,648 crore. EBITDA grew 12% to Rs 5,146 crore, driven by higher cement volumes, improved realisations and strong growth in ready-mix concrete and construction chemicals. Consolidated grey cement volumes rose 12% to 41.31 million tonnes.
